topic: Shanks leaving the Devoted Blades is why Harald got promoted and ended up under Imu's Covenant
title: Shanks Walked Out And Harald Paid The Price
description: Shanks left the Devoted Blades of God, and a giant king ended up owned by Imu's Covenant in his place. Is Harald's chain Shanks' fault, or the Government's?
comment: Is Harald's fate on Shanks for walking out, or entirely on the Government that built the trap? Pick one.
end_text: WHAT THE HOLY LAND REALLY WANTS

lines.text: Shanks walked out of Mary Geoise, and a giant king got stuck holding the leash.

shot.fallback: young red haired noble leaving a white palace

lines.text: Harald served the Government for eighteen years, hoping to win Elbaph a place in it.

shot.fallback: giant king in dark armor kneeling

lines.text: Five years later, Shanks of the Figarland Family joined the same ranks.

shot.search: Shanks Figarland Devoted Blades of God
shot.fallback: young red haired man in a black uniform

lines.text: He was on track for knighthood after one year. Harald needed ten more.

shot.fallback: two warriors, one young, one giant, before a throne

lines.text: Then Shanks worked against the Government in Fisher Tiger's raid, and left.

shot.search: Shanks Fisher Tiger raid Mary Geoise
shot.fallback: young swordsman running through a white palace

lines.text: With Shanks gone, Harald was promoted and got Imu's Depths Covenant.

shot.fallback: dark ruler touching a kneeling giant

lines.text: People say Harald chose that. He signed up for peace, not a leash.

shot.fallback: giant king looking over his peaceful village

lines.text: When Imu ordered him to turn Elbaph into a fighting force, he objected.

shot.fallback: giant king refusing a dark figure

lines.text: Imu used the Covenant to take control anyway, in chapter 1169.

shot.fallback: glowing marks spreading over a giant king

lines.text: So Shanks' escape is why a peaceful giant king got owned.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate emperor on a ship

lines.text: Shanks found the exit. I want to know what everyone else found.

shot.fallback: white holy palace above the clouds

lines.text: Mary Geoise never loses a seat, it just hands the leash to someone who can't refuse, because

shot.fallback: empty throne in a dark hall

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Shanks and the cost somebody else paid, with no mention of the long's rumor.
self_check.loop: The last line ends on 'because' and flows straight into line 1.
